status: original content written for this project; not human-validated
method: STAR-inspired evidence reading (Situation, Task, Action, Result); wording is not required

action: What was your personal responsibility in that?
What did you personally do, as opposed to the team?
result: What happened after you made that decision?
How did it turn out in the end?
measure: How did you measure the outcome?
How did you know it had worked?
reflection: What would you do differently now?
What did you take from that experience?
situation: Could you set the scene a little: when was this, and what was the context?
task: What were you specifically trying to achieve there?

competencies.title: Teamwork and collaboration
competencies.what_we_look_for: How the candidate works with others toward a shared goal: dividing work, supporting colleagues, sharing information.
indicators: names who else was involved and the shared goal
describes their own contribution separately from the team's
shows how they helped others or accepted help
says what the team achieved
competencies.project_prompt: Earlier you mentioned {project}. Who else was involved in it, and what was your own part in the teamwork?

improvement.situation: Open with one or two sentences of context: where, when and why it mattered.
improvement.task: Say what you were specifically responsible for or trying to achieve.
improvement.action: Describe your own steps with "I", then credit the team separately.
improvement.result: Close with what happened, ideally something observable (a number, a decision, feedback), and what you learned.

competencies.title: Conflict resolution
competencies.what_we_look_for: How the candidate handles disagreement: listening, finding the real issue, reaching a workable outcome while keeping the working relationship.
indicators: describes the disagreement specifically and without blaming
shows they listened to the other view
explains what they did to resolve it
says what was agreed and how the relationship went afterwards
competencies.project_prompt: Thinking about {project}: was there a point where you and someone else disagreed about an approach, and how was it settled?

competencies.title: Leadership and ownership
competencies.what_we_look_for: Taking responsibility for an outcome, setting direction, organising others or driving something without being asked.
indicators: makes clear what they were responsible for
shows initiative beyond the minimum
explains how they organised people or work
owns the result, good or bad
competencies.project_prompt: In {project}, which parts did you take ownership of, and how did you decide what to do first?
